name: zeffect_anim_debug_frame_tag
description: zEffect::SetAnimDebugFrameTag records the next video frame tick as the animation debug frame tag.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zEffect animation source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x45d000 validates reading g_zVideo_FrameTick, incrementing it by one, storing that value to g_zEffect_Anim_DebugFrameTag, and returning the same value.
The native smoke verifies the return value and global debug-frame side effect.
